notes.title: Women of Gaming
notes.notes:
Hello i am Lordfish the artist and one of the developers of the game and i want to bring a  messege to you all on this special day. 
First off we can't thank all of the women in our community enough for bringing so many great ideas, creativity, support and wonderful streams. Not to mention our programmer who managed to not only bring us two games in two years but countless updates. This has not been an easy task. A few words about queenfish. Something you should all know is that game developement isn't easy. It takes talent, determination and creativity to say the least. Queenfish well working a full time job  has taught herself to program, animate and so much more. For me, I find it hard not to admire and support her budding talents. That being said i couldn't find a better day to take this chance to mention this to you all and say, like queenfish don't ever accept limitations put on you. 
And with all that said, to celebrate other inspirational women we have added three female youtubers today and 45 new items in total. Queenfish managed this again in such a short period of time because this one was a special one for us. We hope you all enjoy the update and celebrate these lovely ladies with us.

notes.title: Nominate Us Game Of The Year
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for an amazing first year with Yard Sale Simulator. Such a simple premise of attending yard sales and cleaning those dirty items has come so far in such a short time thanks to our wonderful community and our small teams hard work to bring these ideas to life.
Now you can expand your daily activities from salvaging, cleaning, repairing, dumpster diving, metal detecting, reselling, to:
[list]

[*] lock picking
[*] online auctions
[*] storage auctions
[*] helping people around town for rare rewards
[*] hiring employees
[*] find new vehicles
[*] find and keep your favorite YouTubers
[/list]
As the first year wraps up we are hard at work on our biggest update yet. Stay tuned for details as our anniversary fast approaches.

[h1]Happy Halloween[/h1]

We are glad to see people enjoying Yard Sale Simulator's first Halloween event! Thanks to everyone for participating and sharing your videos in our discord.

notes.title: Fish 'n' Friends Update
notes.notes:
[h1]A New Way To Find Items[/h1]

[b]Magnet Fishing Kit[/b]
Grab your metal detector and head on down to the water to get started on your fishing adventure! 
While you are there have a look around for someone in need. They may be able to help you get started.

[b]Find More Valuable Items[/b]
Attach more powerful magnets to up your scavenger game! Magnets can be found in the sand and water or bought from the tool store. Increase your odds of pulling in that precious junk and even find rare items in the right location. Try your luck anywhere in the water but you will have better luck in certain spots.

[h1]New Items[/h1]

27 new items to be bought and found including 2 rare items made in likeness of 2 YouTube personalities you may recognize.

[h1]Fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed vehicles continuous acceleration
[*] Fix for using Tab to close inventory
[/list]

notes.title: Handyman Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Toolbelt[/h1]
Those skilled in repair can head on down to the Tool Shop and pick up a spiffy new belt. Load your belt up with portable tools to free up some precious inventory space and easily access your tools.

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
Now you can yard sale with your controller or Steam Deck!

[/list]

notes.title: Customer Fix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Customers are more likely to stop and buy items at all houses, market stands and businesses.
[*] Slightly higher chance for customers to buy items above average market price.
[*] 1 extra customer will shop at the first small house.

[*] Increased the chance to find items in some dumpsters and trash piles.
[/list]

notes.title: Furniture Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Many New Items[/h1]
Find or buy 70 new items to bring home and fix up. Resell your new items or keep them to spruce up your home.

[h1]New Stores[/h1]
Looking for a certain item to finish off that decor? Head downtown to the furniture or appliance store.
The new stores only sell good quality items at a high mark up. Poor quality and high quality items can be found around town.

[h1]New Vehicles[/h1]
2 new kids vehicles can be found around town.
[b]Custom Flower Wheels[/b]
[list]
[*] Can only be obtained one time per game.
[*] Must complete required task for the owner to sell to you.
[/list]
[b]Other Vehicle[/b]
A rare item that can be obtained multiple times.

[h1]Back up Cam[/h1]
Hitch those trailers with more ease.
The camera will switch on reverse.

[h1]Economy[/h1]
[list]
[*] Customers are less likely to buy over priced items.
[*] Cannot counter offer higher than the original asking price when a customer low balls you.
[*] Decreased chances of finding high quality items.
[*] Items that are not yet on display at yard sales and markets come at an initial 10% discount. (down from 15%) 
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Lamps and fireplaces can be turned on and off when fully cleaned and repaired.
[*] Customers are less likely to buy an item if they are not close to the item.
[/list]

[b]What We Are Working On[/b]
Thank you to everyone for playing and an extra thanks to all the people who took the time to provide feedback and reviews. We are working hard on the next update we hope you will enjoy.
[list]
[*] A whole new fun way to find good and high quality items.
[*] Expanding upon dumpster diving to make it more relevant in later game.
[*] Easier access to portable tools.
[*] More vehicles.
[*] ... and always more items to clean and fix
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Day 1 Fixes[/h1]
[b]After a wonderful day one we bring you these fixes. Thanks for the reports and thanks for playing![/b]
[list]
[*] Fast Freddy has all cars for display but not available for purchase until the required level is reached. Fixing the issue of not being able to purchase after reaching the required level and eliminating floating car :)
[*] Customers will not purchase an item if you are inspecting it. Hopefully solving the issue some were having getting stuck inspecting.
[*] The $1 coin now adds $1.00 to your money instead of going in your inventory and then having to click it to recieve $1.00.
[*] Can no longer add more than one box to your wagon.
[*] Fixed issue with falling asleep at sunset or because of lack of daily stamina while inspecting, buying, selling or dumpster diving.
[*] Fixed tooltip for tables and shelves.
[*] Fixed issue with picking up cards on certain tables
[/list]

notes.title: Lordfish & Queenfish Play Yard Sale Simulator
notes.notes: An open world yard sale simulator. Buy, repair and sell your way to the top. Shop yard sales, hold your own yard sale, buy a market stand, upgrade your stand or open a shop in town to sell all your newly acquired valuables.
